workload: Normal linked QEMU and RPi5 images versus e275083b8 with the existing boot USB storage workload. Compare linked sections, symbol sizes and the Address Device static call frames.
assessment: QEMU ELF is byte-identical. RPi5 text adds 364 bytes, with unchanged data, BSS symbols, DCBAA layout and usable RAM. The static Address Device submission path adds 112 stack bytes before the common ring submit. No physical timing claim.
next_trigger: Measure again when slot reuse, completion ordering, or the output-context storage contract changes.
